results.title: Lizzie
results.overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

results.title: Pūtaringa
results.overview: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

results.title: Never Dies
results.overview: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

results.title: Codes
results.overview: Following a major attack on British soil, a politician discovers the only way of saving his country is by killing the man in front of him.

results.title: Black Cab
results.overview: Harry, a third-generation cab driver in London, struggles to find his place and purpose in a fast-changing world.

results.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api
results.overview: Three best friends are obsessed with becoming firefighters so they can look heroic by putting out fires. However, after failing during their training with the legendary Algojo Api squad, the three find themselves stuck doing seemingly “trivial” assignments. When they attempt to take a shortcut to join the firefighting team as soon as possible, they instead find themselves caught up in a dangerous mission to rescue children from a criminal syndicate.

results.title: Einar Schleef - No Germany Did I Find
results.original_title: Einar Schleef - Ich habe kein Deutschland gefunden
results.overview: With his monumental productions, Einar Schleef pushed theatre to the outer reaches, confounded expectations in East and West alike, grappled with GDR origins and the BRD present. A universal artist emerges from the archive: “I’m not human, I’m dynamite”.

results.title: School Assignment
results.overview: A school boy cannot think what to write in an essay assignment about spring. His father cannot come up with any new ideas either.

results.title: The 12 Dates of Christmas
results.overview: Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

results.title: Putri, Jangan Gentayangan Lagi
results.overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

results.title: Sydney vs. Sean
results.overview: SYDNEY VS SEAN follows Sydney, a red-carpet host chasing perfection, and Sean, a bisexual nurse clinging to independence. A hookup grows into a passionate but volatile romance. After a year apart, the turbulent day of their divorce signing ricochets between past and present. When their eccentric notary arrives, he witnesses two lovers confront a bond that can’t be sustained, yet refuses to fade. Starring JANEL PARRISH (Pretty Little Liars, "To All The Boys" Trilogy) , T.R. KNIGHT (Grey's Anatomy, The Flight Attendant), RYAN POWERS (She-Hulk, The Mandalorian), and ARDEN MYRIN (Free Bert, The Righteous Gemstones)

results.title: Se domani non torno
results.overview: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

results.title: Kommissar Jennerwein – Hochsaison
results.overview: Jennerwein has barely started his job in Garmisch-Partenkirchen when a Danish ski jumper falls to his death, the president of the Winter Games Committee narrowly escapes an assassination attempt, and anonymous letters announce further crimes. Amidst suspicious villagers and vain local politics, Jennerwein must unmask a perpetrator who craves attention and is playing a deadly serious game.

results.title: Santa's Workshop
results.overview: Nine-year-old Mari is really looking forward to Christmas. Her journalist dad, Svein, on the other hand, loves his job so much, he barely notices the festive season. One night, Mari’s Christmas list vanishes – and in its place lies a mysterious mitten. The mitten sends Mari, Svein and her adventurous grandma on an exciting quest to find Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Stubby the Wishlist Elf is in a panic — he’s lost his mitten, which might just lead this curious family straight to the secret location of Santa’s workshop! He must stop them before it’s too late!

results.title: Erased from the Map
results.overview: A man tells a journalist about the photos and memories from his childhood in home and village that will soon disappear for the new national capital city. With his brother, he returns to the places they once played, taking pictures and recreating stories as if the land was still the same.

results.title: Frequency of Fear
results.overview: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

results.title: Block 10
results.overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

results.title: Holofiction
results.overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.
